Nora: @here quick lunchtime proposal: "Sweat & Smiles" challenge tomorrow — 1k sprint relay around the courtyard vs 15-min led boulder ladder on the office wall. Loser stocks the kitchen with protein bars. :yum:
Chris: I'll take the sprint relay. team strategy: no one goes full sprint on lap 1. :running_man:
Dana: Boulder ladder for me. thinking of trying the campus roof auto-belay route if folks are up for it.
Omar: Either, but if it's hot I'd prefer the wall under the fan. Also can we agree on a fun handicap? maybe carry a small plush as a baton for the relay. :t_rex:
Priya: Signup format: `@name - event - meetup - notes`
Chris: `@Chris - relay - courtyard - bring sports water`
Dana: `@Dana - boulder - wall - will bring chalk`
Omar: `@Omar - either - lobby - prefer relay if >3`
Nora: `@Nora - boulder - roof - DJ + foam roller`
Priya: Facilities OK'd courtyard route and extra mats on the wall. Weather says partly cloudy.
Chris: Proposal for handicap: boulder folks add 10s per dyno attempt; relay adds 5s per dropped plush. Fair?
Dana: Sounds hilarious and fair. :joy:
FitBot: Reminder created: "Sweat & Smiles: 1k relay vs boulder ladder" tomorrow 12:20. React with :bell: to confirm.
Omar: :bell: see you all — may ankles be merciful.
Priya: :bell: Smoothie prize for the winner's flavor pick.
Nora: Also tiny rewards: winner gets to pick the playlist next week.
Chris: Deal. Loser buys bars AND performs one celebratory victory dance.
Dana: I accept these terms. See you 12:30!
